mechanism: Budesonide undergoes CYP3A4 metabolism and chloroquine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing budesonide exposure and corticosteroid effects; additionally, both drugs can cause immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypertension, immunosuppression); consider therapeutic drug monitoring or dose adjustment if chloroquine is initiated or discontinued.
